There is the danger that your hands may be crushed, pulled in or otherwise injured.

symex GmbH & Co. KG Rev. 1.1 Order No. SY909735 14 4.3 Fundamental safety measures for normal operation The machine/system must only be operated by authorised persons who are trained on it, know the operation manual and can work in ac- cordance therewith! Prior to switching on the machine, verify and ensure that  only authorised persons are within the work area of the machine  no one can be injured during start-up of the machine! Verify the machine before each production start for visible damage and ensure that it is only operated in a proper condition! Any defects discovered must be reported immediately to a superior! Before starting production, remove material/objects that are not re- quired for production away from the work area of the machine! Before starting production, verify and ensure that all safety devices are working properly! The user must not disable the safety devices on his own authority. symex does not assume any warranty obligation for damage incurred as a result. When entering the target values, the permissible target values indi- cated on the rating plate and in the flow chart must be observed! These must not be exceeded under any circumstances. The mixing vessel can be used with overpressure, vacuum, high tem- peratures and utilizing the pumping capacity of the homogenizer. Whenever opening manually or externally controlled valves with a free outlet, it must be ensured that nobody is standing in the flow direction of the opened pipes. All heating-related components and piping may have high surface temperatures. Furthermore, high temperatures prevail in way of non-insulated sur- faces of the heated mixing vessel. Operating pressures should always be selected at a lower rate than the maximum permitted pressures. Otherwise there is the risk that any existing safety devices will respond. Never reach into the agitator vessel while the agitator is operating. Do not hold any tools, measuring instruments or other objects into the mixing vessel. Do not touch any rotating agitator parts. Please also refer to OEM documentation.

symex GmbH & Co. KG Rev. 1.1 Order No. SY909735 15 Noise The noise level, which the system causes during operation is not constant and not predictable. It depends greatly on the properties of the manufacturing materi- als/products and the installation conditions of the symex mixing system or the exter- nal symex inline device. The operator of symex inline devices must take the necessary noise mitigation measures. The relevant national/local noise protection regulations determine the type and scope of the required measures. Noise protection devices must be available while the system is in operation. Caution The user is obliged to wear an ear protec- tion from a noise level of 80 dB (A). 4.4 Fundamental safety measures for maintenance and repair Inspection and maintenance intervals prescribed in the operation manual must be adhered to (see also separate lubrication and maintenance schedule)! Observe the maintenance and repair instructions in this opera- tion manual for individual components! Set-up, maintenance and repair work may only be executed by trained specialists. Only use perfect tools. Inform operating staff before starting work. Designate supervisors. Prior to performing maintenance and repair work, block access to the work area of the machine to unauthorised persons! Attach or set up a sign calling attention to the maintenance and repair work! Prior to performing maintenance and repair work, turn off the main switch for the power supply and secure with a padlock! The key for this lock must be kept by the person performing the maintenance and repair work! When replacing heavy machine components, use only suitable and perfect load lifting equipment and lifting tackles!

symex GmbH & Co. KG Rev. 1.1 Order No. SY909735 17 4.4.1 Working on the electrical equipment Repair work on the electrical equipment of the machine must only be performed by qualified electricians! Verify electrical equipment at regular intervals! Loose connections are to be retightened! Have any damaged lines/cables replaced immediately! Always keep the control cabinet closed! Access is only allowed to authorised persons with a key/tool! Never hose down control cabinets and other electrical equipment housings when cleaning! Works on any live parts must always be performed by two persons. Use only insulated tools. In case of emergency the second person must acti- vate the EMERGENCY STOP device or main switch immediately. Close off the work area with a red and white safety chain or with a red and white safety tape. Perform maintenance work only when the system is switched off! Only carry out maintenance on the frequency converter and the motor when the main switch is deactivated and after waiting for at least ten minutes and checking that the unit is de energized. System parts on which inspection, maintenance and service works are being carried out must be de-energised as necessary. Isolated parts must be checked for zero po- tential, earthed and short-circuited. Isolate adjacent parts.

Electrostatically chargeable are insulating materials and conductive or dissipative substances, objects and installations that are not grounded. When dealing with liquids, the resulting electrical charge and the level of charging depends on the properties of the liquid, the flow rate, the work processes, the size and geometry of the vessel and the vessel material. The resulting electrical charge of a liquid depends on the dimension of the boundary surface and the flow rate. As second, non-miscible phase, as in, e.g., dispersions or liquid/liquid mixtures, con- siderably increases the charge. Supply of solid matter The homogenizer is designed for homogenising and pumping of liquids with or without solids content. Through faulty operation during homogenisation/pumping of dispersions, se- vere damage may be caused to the homogenizer, in particular to the tool set and the mechanical seal. In case of melting solids (waxes), the system must be heated to at least 80°C before starting to feed the solids into the system. The vessel is then closed, the lower flaps are set to recirculation and the upper flaps to cleaning so that the liquid is pumped back into the vessel by the homogenizer through the via the collector line and the cleaning equipment. During the cleaning process, the homogenizer is operated in the upper speed range. After cleaning, the lower flaps are set to discharge and the cleaning liquid is discharged. The cleaning equipment can also be operated via a separate pump. For this purpose, the pump must be connected on the induction side with the vessel outlet and on the pressure side with the distributor line.
